40001384.author: पदार्थः
40001384.content: राम O Rama, तेषु पुत्रेषु when those sons, हतेषु were killed, दिति: Diti, परमदु:खिता afflicted with great grief, भर्तारम् husband, मारीचम् Maricha, काश्यपम् Kasyapas's son, इदम् अब्रवीत् spoke these words.

40001384.author: Translation
40001384.content: "O Rama! afflicted with great grief when her sons were killed, Diti said to her husband Kasyapa, son of Maricha:

40001385.author: पदार्थः
40001385.content: भगवन् O Adorable one, महाबलै: by the highly powerful, पुत्रै: by your sons, devatas, हतपुत्रा  अस्मि my sons have been killed, शक्रहन्तारम् capable of slaying Indra, दीर्घतपोऽर्जितम् acquire through long austerities, पुत्रम् mighty son, इच्छामि I desire.

40001385.author: Translation
40001385.content: "O adorable one, your highly powerful sons, (devatas) have killed mine through extensive austerities. I am desirous of obtaining a (mighty) son capable of killing Indra.

40001386.author: पदार्थः
40001386.content: सा अहम् I, तप: austerities, चरिष्यामि I shall practise, त्वम् you, ईश्वरम् a supreme ruler of the world, शुक्रहंतारम् capable of slaying Indra, गर्भम् embryo (son), मे to me, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि behoves of you, अनुज्ञातुम् to give consent, अर्हसि behoves.

40001386.author: Translation
40001386.content: I shall practise austerities. You ought to grant me a son who would be the supreme ruler of the world and capable of killing Indra. You can say yes (if you will)".

40001387.author: पदार्थः
40001387.content: तदा then, मारीच: Maricha's son, महातेजा: exceedingly lustrous, काश्यप: Kashyapa, तस्या: her, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमदुखि:ताम् deeply grieved, दितिम् addressing Diti, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40001387.author: Translation
40001387.content: Then, Maricha's son, exceedingly bright Kasyapa on hearing the words of Diti who was deeply grieved replied:

40001388.author: पदार्थः
40001388.content: तपोधने O One having austerities as wealth, एवं भवतु 'Be it so', ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, शुचि: भव become pure, त्वम् you, आहवे in the battle, शक्रहन्तारम् slayer of Indra, पुत्रम् son, जनयिष्यसि will give birth.

40001388.author: Translation
40001388.content: "O one vested with the wealth of austerities be it so. Prosperity to you Remain chaste, you will deliver a son who will kill Indra in the battle.

40001389.author: पदार्थः
40001389.content: त्वम् you, शुचि: भविष्यसि यदि if you remain pure and clean, वर्षसहस्रे thousand years, पूर्णे after completion, मत्त: through me, त्रैलोक्यभर्तारम् lord of three worlds, पुत्रम् son, जनयिष्यसि will give birth.

40001389.author: Translation
40001389.content: "If you remain pure and clean, on completion of a thousand years you will give birth to a son through me who will be the lord of the three worlds".

40001390.author: पदार्थः
40001390.content: महातेजा: highly energetic, स: Kasyapa, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ताम् her, पाणिना with his palm, ममार्ज touched her body gently stroking, समालभ्य having touched her, तत: then, स्वस्ति इति "May good be with thee", उक्त्वा having spoken, स: Kashyapa, तपसे to perform austerities, ययौ had gone.

40001390.author: Translation
40001390.content: Highly brilliant Kasyapa, having thus spoken, touched her gently with his palm, stroked her body and said, "May good betide thee". Having said this, Kasyapa went away to perform austerities.

40001391.author: पदार्थः
40001391.content: नरश्श्रेष्ठ O Foremost of men, तस्मिन् when that Kasyapa, गते (सति) had gone, दिति: Diti, परमहर्षिता was exceedingly delighted, कुशप्लवनम् sacred spot named Kushaplavana, आसाद्य having reached, सुदारुणम् intense, तप: mortifications, तेपे practised.

40001391.author: Translation
40001391.content: "O foremost among men after Kasyapa had left, Diti exceedingly delighted (at the prospect of having sons) reached Kushaplavana, and practised intense mortifications.

40001392.author: पदार्थः
40001392.content: नरश्श्रेष्ठ O Foremost of men, Rama, तस्याम् when she, तप: austerities, कुर्वन्त्याम् while doing, सहस्राक्ष: thousandeyed Indra, परया with great, गुणसम्पदा treasure of virtues, परिचर्याम् service, चकार had made.

40001392.author: Translation
40001392.content: O foremost of men great treasure of virtues while she was practising austerities, the thousandeyed Indra  began to serve her.

40001393.author: पदार्थः
40001393.content: सहस्राक्ष: Devendra, अग्निम् fire, कुशान् Kusha grass, काष्ठम् sticks for burning, अप: water, फलम् fruits, तथैव च and, मूलम् roots, काङ्क्षितम् desired, अन्यत् all other things, यच्च whichever, न्यवेदयत् provided her.

40001393.author: Translation
40001393.content: The thousandeyed Indra served her by providing fire, Kusha grass, sticks for burning, water, fruits, roots and all other things desired by her.

40001394.author: पदार्थः
40001394.content: शक्र: Devendra, गात्रसंवहनै: च एव stroking her limbs gently to regain their suppleness, तथा and, श्रमापनयनै: alleviating her fatigue, सर्वेषु कालेषु at all times, दितिम् Diti, परिचचार ह attended on her.

40001394.author: Translation
40001394.content: Indra attended on Diti, stroking her limbs gently from time to time to help her regain their  suppleness and alleviate her fatigue.

40001395.author: पदार्थः
40001395.content: रघुनन्दन O Joy of Raghus, Rama, अथ thereafter, वर्षसहस्रे when thousand years, दशोने short of ten, दिति: Diti, परमसम्प्रीता highly pleased, सहस्राक्षम् addressing Indra, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40001395.author: Translation
40001395.content: O son of the Raghus ten years before completion of a thousand years. Diti, highly pleased with the services rendered by Indra, addressed him", saying:

40001396.author: पदार्थः
40001396.content: सुरश्रेष्ठ O Excellent among devatas, Indra, याचितेन having been sought, महात्मना by the illustrious, तव your, पित्रा father, वर्षसहस्रान्ते after completion of thousand years, सुतं प्रति about a son, मम to me, वर: boon, दत्त: granted.

40001396.author: Translation
40001396.content: "O best of the gods your illustrious father granted me a boon for a son I sought on completion of a thousand years (of penance).

40001397.author: पदार्थः
40001397.content: वीर्यवताम् among those having prowess, वर excellent, तप: austerities, चरन्त्या: performing, दश ten, वर्षाणि years, अवशिष्टानि remaining, तत: afterwards, भ्रातरम् brother, द्रक्ष्यसे you will see, ते भद्रम् may prosperity to you.

40001397.author: Translation
40001397.content: O the best of the brave ten years is yet to go (for completion of austerities). You will  have a brother. May you prosper

40001398.author: पदार्थः
40001398.content: पुत्र O Son, तम् him, त्वत्कृते for you, जयोत्सुकम् having fortitude for victory, (अहं) समाधास्ये I shall unite him, पुत्र O Son, विज्वर: relieved of grief, त्रैलोक्यविजयम् victory over three worlds, सह भोक्ष्यसि you will enjoy together with him.

40001398.author: Translation
40001398.content: O Child I'll create in him eagerness victory. Together with him you will gain victory over the three worlds. Relieved of sorrows, enjoy you'll with him".

40001399.author: पदार्थः
40001399.content: दिति: देवी Diti devi,  शक्रम् to Indra, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, दिवाकरे when  Sun, मध्यम् midday, प्राप्ते having reached, अथ thereafter, पादौ feet, शीर्षत: head side, कृत्वा having placed, निद्रया by sleep, अपहृता has been overcome.

40001399.author: Translation
40001399.content: After speaking thus to Indra, goddess Diti overpowered with sleep around midsday dropped off, her feet towards her head.

40001400.author: पदार्थः
40001400.content: शक्र: Indra, पादत: towards her feet, कृतमूर्धजाम् with the hairs falling, अशुचिम् impure posture, तां दृष्ट्वा having seen her, शिरस्स्थाने in the place where she should place her head, कृतै placed, पादौ feet (having  seen), जहास laughed, मुमोद च was pleased.

40001400.author: Translation
40001400.content: Indra laughed. He rejoiced at the sight of her ominous posture of sleeping with her feet towards her head and her hair falling on her feet.

40001401.author: पदार्थः
40001401.content: राम O Rama, पुरन्दर: Indra, तस्या: her, शरीरविवरं womb, विवेश च entered, परम् great, आत्मवान् courageous one, गर्भम् embryo, सप्तधा seven pieces, बिभेद severed it.

40001401.author: Translation
40001401.content: O Rama with great courage Indra entered her womb and severed her embryo into  seven pieces.

40001402.author: पदार्थः
40001402.content: राम O Rama, तत: then, शतपर्वणा by the hundred edged, वज्रेण by Vajra, भिद्यमान: being severed, गर्भ: embryo, सुस्वरम् at high pitch, रुरोद cried, तत: then, दिति: Diti, अबुध्यत woke up.

40001402.author: Translation
40001402.content: O Rama that embryo, being severed by Vajra having a hundred edges, cried at high pitch which awakened Diti".

40001403.author: पदार्थः
40001403.content: मा रुद: "Do not weep", मा रुद: "Do not weep", इति शक्र: Indra, गर्भम् addressing embryo, अभ्यभाषत spoke, महातेजा: highly powerful, वासव: Indra, रुदन्तमपि even though crying, बिभेद severed it.

40001403.author: Translation
40001403.content: Highly powerful Indra, even while saying to the crying embryo  "Do not weep, Do not weep" severed it.

40001404.author: पदार्थः
40001404.content: दिति Diti, न हन्तव्य: "Sould not be killed", न हन्तव्य:" should not be killed ", इत्येवम् in this way, अब्रवीत् said, तत: subsequently, शक्र: Indra, मातु: वचनगौरवात् in deference to the words of his mother, निष्पपात came out.

40001404.author: Translation
40001404.content: "Do not kill", "Do not kill", said Diti. Subsequently Indra, in deference to the words of his mother, emerged out of the womb.

40001405.author: पदार्थः
40001405.content: वज्रसहित: armed with Vajra, शक्र: Indra, प्राञ्जलि: with folded palms, दितिम् Diti, अभ्यभाषत spoke, देवि O Devi, पादयो: feet, कृतमूर्धजा hairs falling( on her feet ), अशुचि: becoming impure, सुप्ता असि slept.

40001405.author: Translation
40001405.content: Armed with Vajra, Indra addressed Diti with folded palms, saying, "O Devi you have slept,  with your head towards your feet and your hair falling on your feet".

40001406.author: पदार्थः
40001406.content: अहम् I, तत् that, अन्तरम् opportunity, लब्ध्वा having seized, आहवे in war, शक्रहन्तारम् that one who was to be slayer of Indra, सप्तधा into seven parts, अभिदम् severed, देवि O Devi, त्वम् you, क्षंतुम् to forgive, अर्हसि it is proper.

40001406.author: Translation
40001406.content: "I have seized the opportunity and severed into seven pieces the foetus who would have been a slayer of Indra. O Devi shoudn't you forgive me"? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
